institutions.description: Institutions (open and closed): name, location, charter, regulator, latest assets/deposits. One row per institution (CERT).

filters.desc: Elasticsearch filter: STALP:"WY" AND ACTIVE:1, ASSET:[1000000 TO *], FAILDATE:[2008-01-01 TO 2010-12-31]

fields.desc: comma-separated field names (default: every field, often hundreds); always set this

failures.description: Every FDIC-insured institution failure since 1934: NAME, CERT, FAILDATE, FAILYR, COST (estimated loss to the Deposit Insurance Fund), QBFASSET, QBFDEP, RESTYPE, RESTYPE1, SAVR, PSTALP.

filters.desc: Elasticsearch filter: STALP:"WY" AND ACTIVE:1, ASSET:[1000000 TO *], FAILDATE:[2008-01-01 TO 2010-12-31]

fields.desc: comma-separated field names (default: every field, often hundreds); always set this

agg_by.desc: field to aggregate by, e.g. FAILYR: one row per value with count (and sum_<field>, count_<field>_<value>) instead of records

agg_sum_fields.desc: fields to sum per bucket, e.g. QBFASSET,QBFDEP,COST

agg_term_fields.desc: fields whose values are counted per bucket, e.g. RESTYPE

demographics.description: Quarterly demographic and geographic attributes of institutions (office counts, CBSA, metro flags) keyed by CERT and REPDTE.

filters.desc: Elasticsearch filter: STALP:"WY" AND ACTIVE:1, ASSET:[1000000 TO *], FAILDATE:[2008-01-01 TO 2010-12-31]

fields.desc: comma-separated field names (default: every field, often hundreds); always set this

fields.CERT: FDIC certificate number: the institution id used by every endpoint
fields.NAME: institution name (institutions, failures, locations)
fields.STALP: state postal code (institutions, financials, locations); PSTALP in failures and history
fields.NETINC: net income, thousands of dollars; year-to-date in financials
fields.LNLSNET: net loans and leases, thousands of dollars
fields.REPDTE: report date: YYYYMMDD in financials, MM/DD/YYYY in institutions
fields.COST: estimated loss to the Deposit Insurance Fund, thousands of dollars (failures)
fields.QBFASSET: total assets at failure, thousands of dollars
fields.QBFDEP: total deposits at failure, thousands of dollars
fields.RESTYPE1: transaction type code (failures): PA, P&A, PI, PO (payout), A/A, IDT, MGR, DINB, OBAM, ABT, REP
fields.CB_SI: summary charter group: CB commercial banks, SI savings institutions
fields.DEPSUMBR: branch deposits as of June 30, thousands of dollars (sod)
fields.BKCLASS: charter class (institutions): N national, SM state member, NM state nonmember, SB savings bank, SI state savings institution, SL savings and loan, NC, OI
fields.RESTYPE: FAILURE or ASSISTANCE (open-bank assistance); filter RESTYPE:"FAILURE" to count failures (failures)
fields.REGAGNT: primary federal regulator: OCC, FED, FDIC, ... (institutions)
